dedupe_keys.name: ptc attrezzature e servizi di gestione del rischio e protezione civile

description: PTC - ATTREZZATURE E SERVIZI DI GESTIONE DEL RISCHIO E PROTEZIONE CIVILE is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis2.ar-tel.it. The PTC carries out the preliminary survey of equipment, services, equipment, parks and equipped greenery at municipal and inter-municipal level, with exclusively cognitive value, also identifying the following “Services and equipment of wide area and/or provincial competence” considered essential for the pursuit of the strategies of provincial territorial development and wide area. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PTC – RISK MANAGEMENT AND CIVIL PROTECTION EQUIPMENT AND SERVICES" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
